pages.title: Blood Grate
pages.text: The blood grate is a block that can collect blood from bleeding carcasses. This block will need to be placed directly below the hanging carcass.

Blood from other mods that are supported can be obtain from the blood grate. Do do this you simply need a bucket or a bottle, whilst holding either of these hold Shift and right click the air. This will change the type of blood received.
